task.title: Understanding user interface – SMS web application
task.shortdesc: The login or Dashboard page of the SMS web application provides various intuitive navigation elements.

context.p: The login or Dashboard page of the SMS web application provides various intuitive navigation elements. You can quickly access motor data and plant-specific insights on this page.
The user interface consists of the following major sections:

fig.title: User interface of the web application

context.note: Note: An administrator can view additional menu options under User Profile Settings. They are listed at the end of this table.

row.entry: Displays four menu options that allow you to interact with various sections of the application: Dashboard – Monitor and manage motor health Map – View motors situated across locations on a map Reports – Generate and view reports about specific motors Alerts – Receive alerts about changes in motor status
Allows you to locate the plant, process, or motor information quickly.
Displays motors in a tree view that organizes them by their respective locations, plants, and processes.

Displays analytics summary of the health of all motors across locations. Graph - Displays an interactive doughnut pie chart that visually represents the health of the motors using color-coded status indicators. You can hover over each color to view the number of motors in a specific status. List - Displays the list of all motors along with their corresponding health status. You can click each list item to view detailed health status.
Allows you to switch the interface language to your preferred locale. The application supports five languages: English (EN) Spanish (ES) German (DE) French (FR) Japanese (JA)

Allows users to - modify your user profile settings such as first name, last name, password, and preferred unit of measurement (My profile) select the type of email and push notifications you want to receive (Notifications) sign out of the application (Sign out)
Allows admins to - create and manage users (Admin – Manage users) assign roles modify user details remove users resend invitations manage API settings (API – Manage API Keys)

context.p: Table Interface components of SMS web application
